Shit... shit...
妈……的……妈的……
dataList.place:
Evaluation Arena B1
评审场 地下1层

dataList.content:
It... doesn't matter...
算了……反正……

Jia Qiu, that bastard...
贾丘……那家伙……

... he'll find you... to exact his vengeance for what happened to the Kong family...
他肯定会为了报孔家的仇找到你的……

I know more than you think, Jia Baoyu...
我全都知道，贾宝玉……

I know that the Kong family's annihilation... was the result of a devious machination...
孔家之所以会灭亡……是被诡计所迷惑了……

Daguanyuan bastards... never knowing when they've had enough...
拥有再多都不会满足……大观园的那些家伙们……

You talk too much.
话真多。

Just like any other loser.
和其他失败者一样。

A loser...? I'm not— I'm not a loser...! I've never...
失败者……？我……我不是失败者……！永远不是……

Don't call me a—
不许叫我……

Daiyu...
黛玉……

Why did you help us?
你为什么要帮助我们？

Because lady Baochai is my mistress, not young master Pan. Besides...
因为严格来说我侍奉的不是蟠少爷，而是宝钗小姐。而且……

I wanted to prove to him that he was wrong.
我想告诉少爷，他的话错了。

Big brother Baoyu...
宝玉哥哥……

The Heishou are indeed hiding in every corner of Daguanyuan, but...
就算黑兽已经深入大观园……

... not even they are omnipresent enough to know your every single word, your every action.
他们也不可能知悉哥哥你的所有言行。

So how did Jia Mu come to know them with such detail?
所以老太太是怎么知道哥哥的一切的呢？

Once again, Hong Lu did not reply.
这一次鸿璐也没有任何回应。

This is a special Bolus of my own design.
这是我亲自制造的丸药。
dataList.place:
Hongyuan's Laboratory, Past
过去，鸿园的实验室

dataList.content:
And it was made only thanks to your husband, who, in support of my endeavors, truly did not spare any expenses.
这可都多亏了你先生。他给了我许多支持。

He told me that this project was to be a surprise for you, so feign ignorance for now.
他说想要给你个惊喜，所以具体情况先让我保密，请装作不知情吧。

But... do I dare receive something so valuable...?
但如此珍贵之物……我真的可以收下吗？

I am giving it to you because it is valuable.
正因是珍贵之物，所以才赠予给你。

Remember, that baby you carry is an important, precious child. More deserving of adoration than anyone else. The future of your Kong family.
那即将诞生的孩子，不正是要成为引领孔家，比任何人都高贵的存在吗？

Jia Mu... I want to show this child of mine... a changed Hongyuan.
贾母，我……想给这孩子展示一个……和现在不一样的鸿园。

Imagine, a Hongyuan where people like you can thrive, against all the odds that the world has pitted against them.
一个人人有机会像老太太您一样，不屈从于环境，能凭自己的能力堂堂正正向上攀登的鸿园。

... The karma of your actions shall shape the child within your womb...
……你一举一动所造的业，终究会体现于腹中的孩子上……

So, see, hear, and claim only what is precious, and you shall beget a precious child.
若平时耳濡目染之物皆有贵气，生下的孩子自然也贵气。

If I could be just a bit greedier, I do hope my child would be born with even a fraction of your wisdom, venerable Jia Mu.
稍微贪心一点，这孩子如果能如老太太您一般聪慧就太好了。

Baoyu, our little Baoyu, the gem of our family...
宝玉啊，宝玉啊。我们家族的宝石啊……

Welcome, little Baoyu.
宝玉来了啊。

We have waited long for your arrival.
吾等朝思暮想地等着你呢。

Venerable Jia Mu...
老太太……
dataList.place:
Hongyuan's Laboratory, Past
过去，鸿园的实验室

dataList.content:
We have... but a month left.
现在……只剩不到一个月的时间了。

And we are making steady progress.
进展很顺利。

The results will be as intended.
会得到理想结果的。

Of course, I don't have an iota of doubt in that.
这一点确实毫无疑问。

But...
但是……

Please forgive me for what I am about to say, venerable Jia Mu. But I am starting to get the picture of your... plan.
请您原谅属下无礼，属下似乎已经明白了老太太您想要什么。

I—
属下……

I... I saw the entire procedure, the whole recipe, from the beginning to the end, Jia Mu.
属下已经看到了所有步骤，老太太……

You know what that means.
老太太您应该十分清楚那意味着什么。

Have you forgotten that Daguanyuan stands firmly behind us?
你忘了大观园吗？

Your loyalty to me is loyalty to Daguanyuan itself; do you truly believe that I, its Family Hierarch, shall abandon a loyal follower such as you?
你效忠于我即等同于效忠大观园，身为家主的我岂会对你日后的命运视而不见？

But...
但……

... Understood, Jia Mu...
属下明白了，老太太……

Hm. Her heart has already fallen to the seduction of fear.
唉，她已经被恐惧摄住了心神。

She shall not be long.
那个人也活不了太久了。

Grandma...
奶奶……

I'm... I'm your most precious... treasure, right?
我是……奶奶最珍爱的宝贝……对吧？

You are, little Baoyu.
当然了，宝玉啊。

Then... tell me.
那……告诉我好吗。

What's going to happen here in a month?
一个月之后，这里会发生什么？

Baoyu, do you know which part of the body one must use to bring down the shameless and prideful, yet mighty family? Do you know what shall allow one to exact utter ruin, devastation, and humiliation to such a house?
宝玉啊，那个不知廉耻、骄横跋扈的家族……你可知道，要不留一丝怜悯地让他们家破人亡，最切实的方法是什么？

You use the Head.
那便是首脑。

The plan carries a high risk, but the return shall be just as great. Once mobilized, the Head will be more thorough than anything in the world.
虽然伴随风险，但也有其价值。因为首脑做得比谁都要彻底。

Xiren... what do I do now?
袭人……我，以后该怎么办呢？
dataList.place:
Yihongyuan Interior, Past
过去，怡红院 内部

dataList.content:
... You're not even asking me what happened like you used to.
……你现在都不会像之前那样，问我发生什么事了……

Because nothing will change even if I were to ask you that, young master.
问我也无济于事，少爷。

Something so, so scary, so terrible's gonna happen soon...
之后很快就会发生非常可怕的事……

What... should I do?
我到底该怎么办？

There is no need for one to question the rights and wrongs of the many things that occur here.
在这里发生的许多事情，都不需要去计较是非。

Would you like some tea, young master?
您想用些茶吗，少爷？

I…
我……
